reason: The cargo mesh looks useful for supporting the potato stems as they grow, which matches the current goal.
expectation: I expect the mesh to form some kind of support around the potato trough, though I don't know exactly how it will be fitted.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce is ready to harvest, but I want to address the stated potato goal first.

effect: The mesh supports the spreading potato stems, and the new goal is to taste the first harvest.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the support leave the covered root space intact while giving the stems room.
reason: Harvesting the ready lettuce is the only available combination and fits the new goal.
expectation: I expect the scissors to harvest some lettuce, though preparing it to taste may take another step.

effect: The outer leaves are harvested while the centre remains growing; the first harvest is ready for the galley.
reaction: I like the small detail that the bed can keep growing after this harvest.
reason: Taking the lettuce to the galley is the only available combination and fits the goal of tasting it.
expectation: I expect to prepare or taste the lettuce at the galley, though I don't know exactly what that involves.

effect: The lettuce became part of a fresh meal, completing the harvest goal and the chapter.
reaction: The contrast between the green meal and the barren view outside made the harvest feel significant.

mostWorthwhile.text: Harvesting the outer lettuce leaves while leaving the centre growing was the most worthwhile detail; it showed how the bed could continue producing.

leastWorthwhile.text: Taking the leaves to the galley was straightforward and the only available action, though the resulting meal gave it a satisfying finish.

surprise.text: I was interested that the lettuce could be harvested while the bed kept growing.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: the mesh supported the stems, and the scissors and galley naturally led to a meal.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see the potatoes develop and learn what happens next, though this chapter offered few decisions.
